programmes.title: Agricultural promotion funding (AGRIP)
programmes.description: EU co-funding for campaigns promoting European agricultural products in EU and international markets.
programmes.relationship_to_cap: Not an individual farmer's CAP area-payment application. Keep annual parcel and payment administration separate.
programmes.applicant_summary: For qualifying EU-established organisations with the resources to run a promotional campaign. Being a farmer or making an eligible product does not establish applicant eligibility.
applicant_types: Representative trade/inter-trade organisations and qualifying geographical-indication producer/processor groups
Producer organisations or associations recognised by an EU country
Qualifying public-interest agri-food organisations established for at least two years with sector/product representation
programmes.applicant_limits: Private companies are generally not applicants; narrow group exceptions and all other conditions require the official call and eligibility guidance. No cooperative or individual farm has been confirmed eligible here.

programme_models.description: One or more proposing organisations from the same EU country; national-authority management.
At least two proposing organisations from at least two EU countries, or one or more European organisations; REA management.

call_2026.deadline_qualification: Historical closing date explicitly stated on REA's page checked 17 October 2026; not a new deadline for your farm. No deadline time or timezone established.

future_calls.message: No 2027 call opening or application deadline has been verified. The 2026 page's January 2027 campaign-start milestone is not a 2027 funding call.
